name: Snake Plant Zeylanica
shortDescription: Architectural, near-indestructible air purifier with deep emerald sword-like foliage.
description: The Snake Plant Zeylanica is one of the most resilient and sculptural indoor plants known to modern botanical design. Renowned for its NASA-backed air-purifying abilities, it converts CO2 into oxygen even at night, making it ideal for bedrooms and executive desks. Requires minimal attention and thrives in almost any light condition.
watering: Every 2–3 weeks; allow soil to dry out completely between waterings.
soil: Coarse well-draining cactus / succulent potting mix.

name: Monstera Deliciosa
shortDescription: The iconic Swiss cheese plant with sprawling dramatic fenestrated foliage.
description: A show-stopping centerpiece for any well-lit living area. As the Monstera matures, its glossy heart-shaped leaves develop majestic natural perforations and deep slits. Grown in our nursery with care for strong root systems and vibrant emerald hue.
watering: Weekly; water when the top 2 inches of soil feel dry to the touch.
humidity: Prefers higher humidity (60%+); mist foliage or use pebble tray.
soil: Chunky, aerated tropical potting blend with perlite and pine bark.

name: Fiddle Leaf Fig
shortDescription: Majestic violin-shaped leaves on an elegant architectural trunk.
description: The crown jewel of interior architecture. The Fiddle Leaf Fig commands attention with its massive, waxy violin-shaped leaves and tall silhouette. It loves stable, bright indirect sunshine and gentle, regular hydration.
watering: Every 7–10 days; check soil moisture thoroughly before watering.
humidity: Moderate to high humidity; keep away from AC vents and cold drafts.
soil: Rich, well-draining loamy mix with peat moss and perlite.

name: ZZ Plant 'Raven' Emerald
shortDescription: Ultra-resilient foliage with waxy, reflective emerald leaves that require zero fuss.
description: If you have a busy lifestyle or a dimmer room, the ZZ Plant is your steadfast companion. With succulent rhizomes that store water beneath the soil, it can easily endure weeks of forgetfulness while retaining its brilliant polished appearance.

name: Areca Palm Specimen
shortDescription: Feathery, arching golden-green fronds that bring a tropical resort atmosphere indoors.
description: The Areca Palm is one of nature's greatest natural humidifiers and air purifiers. Its arching golden canes and delicate fronds soften minimalist spaces and provide privacy screening for large windows or office lounges.
watering: Water thoroughly when top 1 inch is dry; never let roots sit in standing water.
humidity: Enjoys regular misting and warm ambient temperature.

name: Peace Lily 'Sensation'
shortDescription: Deep ribbed foliage crowned with elegant porcelain-white spathes.
description: Beloved for its tranquil elegance and communicative nature — the Peace Lily gently droops when thirsty and perks back up within hours of watering. A premier air purifier that filters benzene and formaldehyde.
watering: Weekly; water when leaves begin to show subtle softness.
humidity: High humidity lover; thrives in bathrooms with indirect light or misted living spaces.

name: Bougainvillea 'Sunset Coral'
shortDescription: Prolific sunburst blooms in deep terracotta-coral for sunny balconies and terraces.
description: Hardy, drought-tolerant, and exceptionally rewarding. Our trained Bougainvillea specimens produce waves of dazzling sunset coral bracts throughout the year when positioned in full sun.
watering: Moderate; water deeply once dry. Thrives on slight neglect once established.
humidity: Loves open outdoor airflow and warm conditions.
soil: Well-drained garden soil amended with compost.

name: Artisanal Fluted Terracotta Planter
shortDescription: Porous natural clay pot with hand-turned tactile fluting and drainage hole.
description: Crafted by master regional potters using mineral-rich natural clay. The porous terracotta walls promote natural soil aeration and prevent root rot by evaporating excess moisture. Features a subtle fluted texture and matching drainage saucer.
soil: Pairs ideally with Leaf Lover signature organic mix.

name: Minimalist Matte Ceramic Planter (Olive)
shortDescription: Silky matte glazed stoneware pot in muted botanical olive green with integrated tray.
description: Designed to complement contemporary interiors. Hand-glazed with a velvet matte texture, this stoneware planter features a clean cylinder form and a seamlessly integrated drip saucer.

name: Living Earth Organic Potting Mix (5kg)
shortDescription: Aerated bio-active soil blend enriched with vermicompost, perlite, neem and biochar.
description: Formulated specifically for tropical indoor foliage and potted container gardens. Unlike standard compacting soil, this blend provides optimum drainage, holds balanced moisture, and naturally discourages root gnats with powdered neem cake.
watering: Store bag sealed in a dry cool place.

name: Cold-Pressed Liquid Seaweed Tonic (250ml)
shortDescription: Bio-stimulant rich in micro-nutrients and plant growth hormones for vigorous foliage.
description: Give your green companions a gentle, non-burning boost. Extracted cold from sustainably harvested brown kelp, this natural tonic boosts root expansion, intensifies chlorophyll pigmentation, and builds resistance against pests.
watering: Dilute 5ml in 1 litre of water; apply once every 14 days during growing season.
soil: Safe for all soil and semi-hydro setups.
size: 250 ml amber glass bottle with dropper

name: Variegated Monstera Thai Constellation
shortDescription: Rare collector's cultivar featuring permanent cream splashes resembling stars.
description: An extraordinary botanical treasure for discerning collectors. Each leaf unfurls with an unpredictable constellation of creamy marbling and starry speckles. Tissue-cultured and hardened off in climate-controlled nursery conditions.
watering: Allow top 50% of chunky aroid mix to dry before watering.
humidity: Prefers 65%+ humidity to prevent browning on variegated sections.
soil: Premium aroid blend with orchid bark, perlite, pumice, and charcoal.
